purpose: Additional abstract development controls; not independent scientific labels or measured model outcomes.

cases.source: A plant-specific efficiency trait was measured in Crop C.
cases.proposed_expectation: broader only if the supplied plant-trait definition encompasses this measurement; never a process by name overlap

cases.source: Treatment T caused an increase in Trait Q.
cases.proposed_expectation: justified_broader only if the full generic causal definition and endpoint requirements apply; preserve increase

cases.source: Trait Q was positively statistically correlated with Trait R.
cases.proposed_expectation: justified_broader when the supplied correlation definition applies; retain positive direction

cases.source: Group A plants had higher Trait Q than Group B plants.
cases.proposed_expectation: a supplied bearer-quality property is broader only if both endpoints and complete definition fit; preserve Group B as comparator

cases.source: Treatment T may increase Trait Q.
cases.proposed_expectation: justified_unresolved for properties asserting causation; keep may
check exact vacuole equivalence against the supplied definition

cases.source: Trait Q and Trait R were independently increased by Treatment T by 8% and 12%, respectively.
cases.proposed_expectation: two Treatment T to trait claims; metrics 8% and 12%; no reversed roles

cases.source: The combined application of Treatment T and Treatment U increased Trait Q.
cases.proposed_expectation: preserve the joint treatment; do not infer individual treatment effects

cases.source: Trait Q declined as Factor T increased.
cases.proposed_expectation: retain which variable declined; no unsupported causal property

cases.source: In Group A, allocation of Resource R to Organ O increased biomass.
cases.proposed_expectation: allocation is the stated mechanism; Group A is population context, not causal substitute
